title: Reject stale tool evidence before external decisions
narrative: Fangore starts the CLI host with family `pass_through` and backend `mock`. He runs `tool_result_freshness`: an eight-day-old CRM cache and an expired quote are rejected as errors; a live CRM result within TTL passes. Context freshness scoring in `fangore_jev_context_budget_pack` and `fangore_insp_context_provider` covers retrieved context; this story covers typed tool-result TTL. Tracks MH-PA-01[^insp-pa-01].
implementation: `ToolResultFreshnessPolicy.reject_if_stale` via product verb `tool_result_freshness` (`cli_policy_verbs`). Walk-bag `in`/`out` carry policy inputs and rejected/passed ids.
validation: Harness `user_story` walks `tool_result_freshness`; expects rejected_ids and passed_ids.
